title: Q-ROOT-unclassified: unclassified keeps recurring: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `unclassified` recurred on 5 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24, 2026-11-25); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: no root-cause class explains this finding
Guard: `file:doctrine/rootcauses.json`
Remedy: Add a root-cause class (id, match, root, guard, remedy) to doctrine/rootcauses.json for these findings.
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:dg-empty-commits: dg-empty-commits a bot commits without comparing trees OW-NOOP-1)
x refs/remotes/origin/parked/claude/project-thread-c0q
- failure-audit:live-verify: live-verify a public surface no longer reads what the code says it serves (zero changes, a wrong claim, a dead page) : "
- failure-audit:selftest-data: selftest-data a generator that feeds a public page stopped running, or its output never lands on main site/feed-data.js:
- failure-audit:selftest-workflows: selftest-workflows a scheduled workflow fails every run or stopped being scheduled, and no check watches it l failed
ult
- failure-audit:sla-breach: sla-breach an item outlived its written SLA because no loop owned its state slawatch: ultrastable/ops unmeasured (gh pr 
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe unclassified

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-25T21:15:13Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 98.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
